# Kalk Solutions

> India's Manufacturing Growth System. We help manufacturers (₹5 Cr–₹50 Cr in India and $1M–$50M globally) generate high-value B2B opportunities, control their sales process, and implement Odoo ERP — through one integrated system. Based in Pune, India.

## What we do
- Lead generation for manufacturers (Google, LinkedIn, SEO, content)
- Sales control system (CRM deployment, automation, pipeline reporting)
- Odoo ERP implementation (Silver Partner, moving to Gold)
- Buyer-magnet websites and international positioning

## Proven outcomes
- ₹25 Crore single RFQ generated for a steel/metal manufacturer in Maharashtra
- Saudi Aramco supply opportunity created for a precision parts manufacturer in Pune
- 30+ manufacturers scaled across India and the Gulf
- ERP transformations consolidating 5–6 disconnected tools into one Odoo system

## Pricing
- India: from ₹1,00,000 / month for the full Growth System
- International: from $2,500 / month — 40% below US/UK agency rates
- ERP implementations: ₹2–20 lakhs (India) / $5K–$40K (international)
